title: Dancing With the Stars
subtitle: Super Bowl Night
description:
Season 35; Episode 6 (2026)
Julianne Hough (Host), Alfonso Ribeiro (Host), Bruno Tonioli (Judge)
Director: Phil Heyes
The remaining 11 couples perform songs made famous by some of the most iconic Super Bowl performances throughout the years; sportscaster Joe Buck joins as a guest judge.

title: FOX NFL Kickoff
description:
Episode 7 (2026)
Charissa Thompson (Host), Charles Woodson (Host), Julian Edelman (Host)
FOX NFL Kickoff is hosted by Charissa Thompson alongside Pro Football Hall of Famer and Super Bowl champion Charles Woodson, three-time Super Bowl champion Julian Edelman and longtime sports media personality Colin Cowherd.

title: FOX NFL Sunday
description:
Episode 7 (2026)
Curt Menefee (Host), Terry Bradshaw (Host), Howie Long (Host)
Hosts Curt Menefee and Terry Bradshaw with analysts Howie Long, Michael Strahan and Rob Gronkowski. FOX NFL insider Jay Glazer returns with the FOX NFL Sunday crew, delivering exclusive insights and breaking news across the league.

title: The NFL Today
description:
Episode 12 (2026)
James Brown (Host), Bill Cowher (Host), Nate Burleson (Host)
Featuring highlights, analysis, and the latest news across the league with host James Brown alongside analysts Nate Burleson, Bill Cowher, Russell Wilson and Kyle Long.

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Chicago Bears at Atlanta Falcons
description:
The Atlanta Falcons host the Chicago Bears in NFL regular-season Week 6 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Atlanta relies on Bijan Robinson following his 145-yard rushing game, while Chicago seeks a repeat of its 37-17 victory from the previous meeting.
2026-2027 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers
description:
The Pittsburgh Steelers visit the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in an NFL Week 6 game at Raymond James Stadium. Pittsburgh has dominated the historic game, winning their last regular-season meeting 20-18 against Tampa Bay at Acrisure Stadium in October 2022.
2026-2027 at Raymond James Stadium

title: NFL on FOX Postgame
description:
Curt Menefee (Host), Terry Bradshaw (Host), Howie Long (Host)
Scores and highlights from around the NFL, with hosts Curt Menefee and Terry Bradshaw along with analysts Howie Long, Jimmy Johnson and Michael Strahan.

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Buffalo Bills at Las Vegas Raiders
description:
The Las Vegas Raiders host the Buffalo Bills in NFL Week 6 at Allegiant Stadium. Buffalo has won three straight in this series. The Bills look to Josh Allen, who leads the offense, while the Raiders look to Kirk Cousins as both seek momentum.
2026-2027 at Allegiant Stadium

title: Football Night in America
description:
Maria Taylor (Host), Jason Garrett (Host), Mike Tomlin (Host)
"Football Night in America" features host Maria Taylor, former NFL head coach and quarterback Jason Garrett, former NFL head coach Mike Tomlin and NFL insider Mike Florio recapping the day's NFL highlights.

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers
description:
The Packers host the Cowboys in NFL Week 6 action at Lambeau Field. The sides drew 40-40 in their last meeting at AT&T Stadium in September 2025. The Cowboys look to Dak Prescott to lead the offense while Jordan Love who anchors the Packers.
2026-2027 at Lambeau Field

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Washington Commanders at San Francisco 49ers
description:
The San Francisco 49ers host the Washington Commanders in NFL Week 6 at Levi's Stadium. San Francisco has taken three of the last five. The 49ers look to Brock Purdy to lead the offense while the Commanders counter with Jacory Croskey-Merritt.
2026-2027 at Levi's Stadium
